description: This PHP interface defines the OperatorInterface for filters in the SuiteCRM JSON API module. It specifies methods for obtaining filter and SQL operators, checking an operator, and converting operands, serving as a contract for implementing classes.
external_methods: PHP's interface syntax and method declarations

classes.name: OperatorInterface
classes.description: Defines a contract for filter operators used in the SuiteCRM JSON API, requiring methods to return filter and SQL representations, validate operators, and convert operands.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter format of the operator as a string.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL format of the operator as a string.

methods.name: isOperator
methods.description: Checks if the provided string matches the operator, returning a boolean.

methods.name: toSqlOperands
methods.description: Converts an array of operands into an SQL-compatible string.
